description: Multi-agent task board with workflow templates, budgets, approval gates, channel notifications, and memory-injected workers. Workers drive the board through 14 board_* tools; humans drive it through ./do board, /board, the dashboard, REST, and OpenAI-compat.
reminder_message: 🗂 Vodou-Board exposes board_* tools ONLY when VODOU_BOARD_TASK is set in the env. Normal chat sessions see no board tools. Workers spawned by the dispatcher start with this env set; humans interact via ./do board ... or the dashboard.

notes.database: board.db lives at project root. WAL mode. ATTACHes vodou-core.db (always) and memory.db (when present) for cross-table reads.
notes.read_path: tools/show, list, search, assignees read board.db directly in READONLY mode.
notes.write_path: tools/complete, block, heartbeat, comment, create, link, unblock, artifact, request_approval POST to the gateway at http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/board/* with VODOU_BOARD_WRITE_TOKEN bearer auth (per-task HS256-signed JWT).
notes.gating: VODOU_BOARD_TASK env var — check_fn returns true iff present. Workers see all 14 tools; chat sessions see zero.
notes.ask_path: tools/ask hits POST /api/board/ask which calls src/board/ask.rs (hybrid search over board corpus + LLM-router fallback).
notes.fallback_mode: If gateway HTTP is unreachable, write tools fall back to writing to board.db directly with _orphan_event=true; the dispatcher reconciles on next start.
notes.phase1_status: Server scaffold + manifest + db/gating/types/gateway-client modules shipped. Tool handlers land Day 5-6 of the BUILD-PHASE-1-CHECKLIST.md plan.
